title: Normalized affine unit mate is invertible on K-flat tilde models
statement: Let g:Spec B to Spec R be any morphism of affine schemes [def-pc-scheme]. Use the fixed extension/restriction and pullback/direct-image adjunctions and affine derived global sections of [def-pc-affine-global-hom-base-change-map]. Let v and r be the underived and derived sections/direct-image comparison isomorphisms, with v identity on all sections and r satisfying the right-derived-unit normalization of lean.statement. For any K-flat R-module complex M [def-pc-module-kflat-complex], put Q=Q(tilde M). The transpose under affineDerivedExtensionAdjunction of Gamma_R(unit_g(Q)) followed by r at Lg*Q is an isomorphism. No flatness of g or boundedness of M is required.

source.place: Tags 06Z0, 08DV, 08DW and 0AA7: affine model computation and extension/restriction adjunct

proof.text: Use the fixed extension/restriction and tensor-pullback adjunctions to supply additivity. Construct the natural ordinary affine model isomorphism c with its extension/pullback unit equation.
Apply the derived model factorization to c.hom and its unit equation, obtaining isomorphisms a,b and n b=a Q(c_M).

Since c is a natural isomorphism, its termwise complex map and its localization Q(c_M) are invertible. The right side a Q(c_M) is invertible. Cancel the invertible b on the right using IsIso.of_isIso_fac_right to prove that n is invertible.
